urls.rationale: Ch. 24.45 Art. 1 - Legislative Declaration of Purpose; framing article for the lobbying-disclosure regime.
Ch. 24.45 Art. 2 - Administration; defines administering authority for the lobbying-disclosure statute.
Ch. 24.45 Art. 3 - Disclosure: Registration and Reports; the central lobbyist-registration and reporting provisions.
Ch. 24.45 Art. 4 - Penalties and Enforcement; cross-referenced enforcement provisions for the disclosure obligations.
Ch. 24.45 Art. 5 - General Provisions; definitions and miscellaneous provisions used throughout the lobbying-disclosure chapter.
